result.summary: Review at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (branch feature/binary-config-serve-20260930), scope: Freestyle pause/resume/cancel/destroy/isRunning behaviour, ambiguous provider state and guest disappearances. Verdict FINDINGS: 1 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. HIGH: a pause intent racing an out-of-band guest pause leaves previous_state="paused", after which resume_worker reports success and emits worker.resumed while the worker stays paused forever (reproduced; queued follow-ups accepted and never delivered). MEDIUM: the stopped-guest reconcile branch keeps a stale deadline_at so follow-ups fail instantly with 'Worker task timed out' (reproduced). MEDIUM: cancel_worker records cancelled with no error when the OpenCode stop cannot be proven, unlike fail/destroy which go recovery_required (reproduced). LOW: control() returns before applying its intent when a step holds the lock; LOW: vanished guest in step() leaves the inference gauge/excerpt. No source changes. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json.
result.details:
Setup: /workspace/repo left at baseline 5672ead, clean and unmodified; disposable detached checkout at /tmp/r26/t verified with git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Bun 1.4.2 installed at /tmp/bun1420 (snapshot 1.3.14 cannot read this lockfile; lockfile never rewritten).

Findings (file:line at exact target):
A HIGH src/coordinator.ts:851 - applyControl pause records previous_state: w.state unguarded (851-855); resume transitions to w.previous_state ?? "ready" (861). A pause intent is recorded before the worker lock is taken (833), and the running/waiting branch of step transitions the worker to paused without re-reading intent (497-503), so previous_state can become "paused". Reproduced (/tmp/r26/exp/pause-intent-race.test.ts): state=paused previous_state=paused; resume returns paused, paused_at=null, events ...worker.paused -> worker.resumed; runTick skips paused workers (344-349) so no deadline/monitoring/usage; queueMessage still returns delivery "queued" (226-237) and the message never runs. Fix: return early when already paused, or validate previous_state in resume (fallback "ready"), and re-check intent before the paused transitions.
B MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:429 - stopped-guest recovery_required omits deadline_at: null (contrast 573-577, 800-804, 919-921, 936-941); the follow-up transition (238-243) does not reset it and the deadline check (452-455) fires before prepare. Reproduced: recover -> recovery_required with past deadline; message -> booting/queued; tick -> failed 'Worker task timed out', repeatable. Nothing starts a stopped guest on the follow-up path.
C MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:890 - cancel inspects only quiesce's "missing" outcome and ignores "paused" (725-745), so an unprovable stop records cancelled with error=null and a still-running guest, while fail (785-804) and destroy (917-926) treat it as unsafe. Reproduced.
D LOW src/coordinator.ts:251 - exclusive() returns the in-flight promise, so control() can return before its intent is applied (observed: pending_control still set on return); docs/MCP-API.md:11 allow "pending intent" for pause. Fix: queue behind the lock or wait for intent to clear.
E LOW src/coordinator.ts:487 - vanished guest in step() omits inference/excerpts delete that reconcile does at 408-419 (<=30 s self-heal).

Tests: bun install --frozen-lockfile exit 0 (125 packages); bun test tests/lifecycle.test.ts tests/core.test.ts exit 0, 44 pass / 0 fail (baseline green); bun test /tmp/r26/exp/pause-intent-race.test.ts 1 pass; bun test /tmp/r26/exp/cancel-stopped.test.ts 2 pass. Only the repository FakeProvider/FakeAgent doubles and in-memory SQLite were used; no real provider, inference endpoint or credential was contacted.

Limitations: Freestyle never called (doubles model pause/resume/quiesce); A and D were reproduced by explicitly gating the injected getWorker rather than by chance; prepare-on-stopped-guest is code-evidenced only; full suite, tsc/biome and packaging were out of scope. Report: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json.
